title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Included Emergency Dispatches and the Surcharge
content:
Each program of the Demand Service Rate Programs includes a number of emergency dispatches per program year before the
emergency surcharge applies, and names the surcharge charged per emergency dispatch beyond those
included calls.

| Program | Emergency dispatches included per program year | Surcharge per dispatch beyond the included calls (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 0 | 350 |
| Priority Response Program | 1 | 295 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 2 | 250 |
| Emergency Response Program | 6 | 195 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 12 | 150 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 24 | 0 |

**How the two columns read together.** The included figure is a count of dispatches for the program
year; the surcharge figure is a money amount in US dollars attaching to a dispatch beyond that count.
The Time & Material Account includes 0 emergency dispatches, so its surcharge of 350 US dollars attaches
to every emergency dispatch taken on that program. At the other end the Dedicated Technician Program
includes 24 dispatches and its surcharge stands at 0, so no surcharge attaches however many are taken.

**Basis questions.**

*What does a program year mean for the included figure?* It is the number credited for one program year,
not for the life of the program.

*Does the surcharge figure vary with the length or hour band of the call?* No. It is a figure per
dispatch beyond the included calls, and the columns above are the whole of it.
